'95 Shop: 30th Anniversary

To celebrate eBay's 30th anniversary, Pop Up Mob brought the brand's origins into the present through the '95 Shop, an experiential retail concept rooted in the spirit of its early marketplace, translated for a new generation.

TechSeptember 2025NYC, New York50% Experiential
The Story
NYC, New York

Located in SoHo, NYC, the space transformed eBay's digital ecosystem into an IRL discovery experience, where hundreds of listings came to life through curated displays and 4 eBay Sellers sold directly on site and displayed hundreds of their listings, actively transacting with visitors. Blending commerce and content, eBay Live streamed real-time sales directly from the space, while immersive photo moments and a bold 3D logo installation invited guests to engage, capture, and share their experience. Supported by exclusive anniversary merch and a vibrant, archive-inspired environment, the activation celebrated eBay's community-driven DNA, bridging past and present while redefining what a marketplace can feel like in the physical world.
